name: Appraisal Kit I
contents: Pocket-sized inspection and measuring aids for judging an object's worth on the spot.

name: Appraisal Kit II
contents: A bag of valuation gear that adds weighing, lighting and photography aids to the grade I tools.

name: Appraisal Kit III
contents: A fixed appraisal lab with laboratory instruments, protective storage and reference material on top of the grade II gear.

name: Architect’s Kit I
contents: Hand drafting tools and paper for sketching and measuring plans.

name: Architect’s Kit II
contents: A drafting station: the grade I tools plus a proper table and large drawing surfaces.

name: Architect’s Kit III
contents: A design studio adding computer drafting, printing and scale-model supplies to the grade II setup.

name: Authentication Kit I
contents: Hand-held optics and special lights for checking whether an item is genuine.

name: Authentication Kit II
contents: The grade I tools plus scanning hardware and comparison software for closer study.

name: Authentication Kit III
contents: A fixed document-examination lab with high-end imaging and comparison equipment beyond the grade II gear.

name: Chemistry Kit I
contents: A compact set of glassware, measuring tools and basic heat for simple chemical work.

name: Chemistry Kit II
contents: A bench chemistry setup that extends the grade I set with better optics, heating and sample-handling equipment.

name: Chemistry Kit III
contents: A fixed laboratory with ovens, heavy analysis equipment and reference works on top of the grade II bench.

name: Cleaner Kit I
contents: Everyday cleaning supplies, coverings and fasteners for tidying a scene quickly.

name: Cleaner Kit II
contents: The grade I supplies plus tools for monitoring responders and for moving or burying what must disappear.

name: Cleaner Kit III
contents: The grade II gear plus heavy cutting tools, destructive agents and planted false evidence for a thorough job.

name: Climbing Kit I
contents: Personal rope, harness and basic hardware for one climber.

name: Climbing Kit II
contents: The grade I gear plus technical protection and ice equipment for difficult ascents.

name: Climbing Kit III
contents: Enough grade II climbing gear to outfit a team of 6.

name: Construction Kit I
contents: Hand and power tools with safety wear for basic building work.

name: Construction Kit II
contents: The grade I tools plus workshop machines for cutting, shaping and cleanup.

name: Construction Kit III
contents: The grade II workshop plus light site machinery, portable power and a transport trailer.

name: Demolitions Kit I
contents: Small non-sparking hand tools and inspection aids for careful work on explosive devices.

name: Demolitions Kit II
contents: The grade I tools plus firing equipment, detonators and lengths of wire and fuse.

name: Demolitions Kit III
contents: The grade II gear plus remote inspection and detection instruments, extra tools and reference manuals.

name: Disguise Kit I
contents: Basic makeup and adhesives for changing a face.

name: Disguise Kit II
contents: The grade I makeup plus spare outfits, hairpieces and small props for a fuller change of look.

name: Disguise Kit III
contents: The grade II gear plus prosthetics, mask-making supplies and subject reference files for deep impersonation.

name: Electronics Kit I
contents: Small hand tools and soldering supplies for working on circuits.

name: Electronics Kit II
contents: A workbench set that adds test instruments, static protection and spare components to the grade I tools.

name: Electronics Kit III
contents: A fixed electronics lab with a small clean room and advanced test and chip-programming equipment beyond grade II.

name: First Aid Kit I
contents: Dressings, splints and basic supplies for treating minor injuries.

name: First Aid Kit II
contents: A medic's bag that adds examination tools, wound-closing supplies, medication and a stretcher to the grade I supplies.

name: First Aid Kit III
contents: Paramedic-level gear: the grade II bag plus resuscitation, fluid, oxygen and spinal-support equipment.

name: Forensics Kit I
contents: Protective wear, markers and simple probes for documenting a scene.

name: Forensics Kit II
contents: The grade I gear plus weather protection, chemical test supplies and evidence-collection materials.

name: Forensics Kit III
contents: A mobile crime-scene unit that adds search, casting, lighting and ballistic analysis equipment to the grade II gear.

name: Forgery Kit I
contents: Fine blades, inks, stamps and brushes for hand-altering or copying documents.

name: Forgery Kit II
contents: The grade I tools plus scanning, laminating and finishing machines and security-feature materials.

name: Forgery Kit III
contents: The grade II setup plus a small press and casting supplies for producing convincing physical copies.

name: Lockpicking Kit I
contents: A pocket set of picks and small tools for opening simple locks.

name: Lockpicking Kit II
contents: The grade I picks plus vehicle-entry tools and cutting and drilling tools for forced or bypass entry.

name: Lockpicking Kit III
contents: The grade II tools plus key-making equipment, practice locks, a probe and manufacturer references.

name: Mechanics Kit I
contents: A toolbox of common hand tools and a jack for routine mechanical work.

name: Mechanics Kit II
contents: The grade I toolbox plus diagnostic equipment, power tools and shop lighting.

name: Mechanics Kit III
contents: A full garage: the grade II tools plus lifting gear, bench machines, welding equipment and compressed air.

name: Surgery Kit I
contents: Basic sterile instruments and supplies for cutting and closing wounds.

name: Surgery Kit II
contents: The grade I instruments plus sterile-field supplies, injected drugs and faster wound-closing tools.

name: Surgery Kit III
contents: An operating-room set that adds major-surgery instruments, monitoring, blood, anesthesia and oxygen to grade II.
